keywords.title: Searches
keywords.description: What to look up, as you'd type it into eBay, such as "Trek FX 2 Disc hybrid bike medium". One search per line.

count.title: Sales per search
count.description: How many kept sales to return for each search.

daysToScrape.title: Days back
daysToScrape.description: Only sales that ended in this many days. eBay keeps about 90 days of sold listings.

itemCondition.title: Condition
itemCondition.description: Only new, only used, or any condition.

ebaySite.title: eBay site
ebaySite.description: Which eBay to search. Prices are read in US dollars, so ebay.com works best.

includeExcluded.title: Also return screened-out sales
includeExcluded.description: Return lots, bundles, parts, and empty-box sales too, each with its excludedReason. They never count toward the price spread.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: eBay blocks some datacenter addresses. Residential proxies are the most reliable.
